name: HPSO
one_liner: Individual malpractice insurance for counselors, social workers, students and other health professionals, underwritten by CNA.
short_description: HPSO sells individual professional liability policies to counselors, social workers, students and many other health professions, underwritten by a CNA company.
long_description: HPSO (Healthcare Providers Service Organization) is a trade name of Affinity Insurance Services, an Aon affiliate, and administers professional liability insurance for many health professions, mental-health counselors and clinical social workers among them. Policies are underwritten by American Casualty Company of Reading, Pennsylvania, a CNA company, and are offered through more than 40 endorsing partners, including the American Counseling Association. Individual coverage is up to $1 million per claim and $3 million aggregate, with sole coverage and no shared limits. HPSO's occurrence policy form includes license protection for licensing board complaints and deposition representation when you are subpoenaed, and HPSO says its policies respond to depositions, subpoenas and license complaints. The counselor policy includes telehealth services. Coverage is for individuals, not practices, incorporated entities or DBAs; HPSO also sells student and school blanket coverage, with discounts for students and recent graduates. Annual rates come from an online quick quote. HPSO publishes counselor claim reports with CNA.
best_for: Licensed counselors buying an individual policy
Clinical social workers who want coverage separate from an employer's policy
Counselors who belong to an endorsing association such as ACA
not_for: Practices that need entity, incorporated or DBA coverage
Psychologists, for whom HPSO pages reviewed showed no dedicated program

faqs.a: American Casualty Company of Reading, Pennsylvania, a CNA company. HPSO is a trade name of Affinity Insurance Services, an Aon affiliate.

faqs.q: What limits does HPSO offer counselors?
faqs.a: Individual coverage of up to $1 million each claim and up to $3 million aggregate, with no shared limits.

faqs.q: Does HPSO cover licensing board complaints and depositions?
faqs.a: Yes. The policy form includes license protection for licensing board complaints and deposition representation when you are subpoenaed.

faqs.q: Can HPSO insure my group practice?
faqs.a: Not through its individual program. HPSO says individual coverage is for individuals, not practices, incorporated entities or DBAs.
